title: RQG Item - gear
description: Generated JSON Schema for the "gear" Item DataModel's `system` data. Source: src/data-model/item-data/gear-data-model.ts. Do not edit by hand — run `pnpm generate:schemas`.

physicalItemType.title: Item type
physicalItemType.description: Whether the item is one of a kind (unique) or a stack of identical items (consumable).

quantity.title: Quantity
quantity.description: How many of the item the character has.

location.title: Location
location.description: Name of the container item that holds this item. Blank when it is not inside one.

isContainer.title: Is container
isContainer.description: Whether other items can be stored inside this one.

attunedTo.title: Attuned to
attunedTo.description: Free text noting who the item is attuned to. Does not identify a stored magic item.

equippedStatus.title: Equipped status
equippedStatus.description: Where the item is: carried, equipped, or stored away. Only equipped items count as worn or wielded.

estimated.title: Estimated price
estimated.description: The price players believe it has, before it is identified.

max.title: Capacity
max.description: Most magic points the item can store.

identified.title: Identified
identified.description: Whether the players can see the stored magic points and use them.

storedMagicPoints.title: Stored magic points
storedMagicPoints.description: Magic points kept in the item, for example in a POW-storing crystal. They can be spent when casting.

boundSpiritActorUuids.title: Bound spirits
boundSpiritActorUuids.description: UUIDs of the spirit actors bound into the item by a Binding Enchantment.

matrixSpells.title: Matrix spells
matrixSpells.description: Spirit magic spells stored in the item by a Spell Matrix Enchantment. Each entry holds a link to the spell, its points and its sort order.
